scope: Corrected direct joint FP4 lookup/native producer in complete E104 FFN. One architecture-family repair, not a new unrelated family.

cause_and_repair.inherited_transfer_defect: v7c-style padded HBM-to-joint DMA emitted 58,982,400B per29,491,200B input and source range57,600B beyond its allocation. v2/v3 graph verified; historicalimage causality not independently isolated.
cause_and_repair.repair: compact HBM load plus exact raw FP4 Main copies into full Projection2/Row30 joint buffer
cause_and_repair.fallback: Removed after direct_fixed passed the same exact row oracle as hybrid; no16row-specific branch and no broader fallback sweep.

materialized_control.interpretation: Unresolved newly compiled diagnostic failure; not a passing E104 production control.

limits: Exact synthetic oracle does not prove arbitrary public-input correctness.
Probe passes the same blockscale tensor to both projections, so it cannot detect swapping the two blockscale inputs. WholeFFN graph uses distinct IO5/IO6 and standard public tests passed.
Corrected ingress and new raw-copy scheduling changed together; no unique hardware root cause is proven.

static_cycles.interpretation: Not a hardware performance oracle or measured stall fraction.

closure_reason: Measured target-kernel improvement is below the provisional5percent screen. Additional packed assembly and the combined lookup/native path did not produce a large wholeFFN gain. No repeated runs, expanded correctness, adoption, or parameter tuning are justified by this screen.
retained_finding: The direct lookup/native family is expressible and passes this wholeFFN standard correctness gate after correcting source-transfer contracts. Historical failure is not proof of a universal native-DPE composition limitation.
root_authorization: Root explicitly closed this implementation after the first screen; candidate and report files authorized for commit only.
